sections.title: Meningitis outbreak
sections.highlight: Emergence of Meningitis cases is very likely and epidemics status possible in Mali, Niger, and Chad. Emergence of Meningitis cases is likely in Western Sahara, Mauritania, Senegal, Algeria, Burkina Faso, Benin, Nigeria, Cameroon, and Sudan.
